div.div:
Retries and termination guards
Validated list/ranking/count/selection/obstacle queries retry up to parse_retries + 1 attempts (default: 2); an invalid pairwise result leaves the incumbent winner unchanged. Arrival or turn parse failure aborts navigation.
Also fail on empty target sets, max_pickups = 8, navigation timeout, missing unvisited target, or manual interrupt. Camera and Bluetooth are closed in finally.
